'''January 2001 Rochester tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Millennium Games, Rochester, NY on 27 January 2001. [[R. Smith]] won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1686">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-rochester-ny-1-27d1686/ rochester-ny-1-27], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 29 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-rochester-ny-1-27d1686/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Millennium Games, Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[R. Smith]]
